Небольшой контекст: #Математика и черт - это советский кратко-метражный черно-белый фильм, являющийся продукцией ЦЕНТРНАУЧФИЛЬМ. Великая Теорема Ферма состоит в утверждении, что при значениях $n > 2$ уравнения вида $x^n + y^n = z^n$ не имеют ненулевых решений в натуральных числах. Краткое содержание: #Вкратце, фильм рассказывает историю о математике, который случайно обранив выражение “За решение этой задачи заложил бы ему душу”, вызывает настоящего черта у себя в хоромах. В итоге, профессор договаривается с чертом, что черт получит его душу, если тот принес решение ВЕЛИКОЙ ТЕОРЕМЫ ФЕРМА в течение 24 часов, иначе нечисть должен будет обеспечить профессору и его жене счастливую жизнь. Бес оказывается необразованным в сфере математики настолько, что тот рисовал цифру в квадрате буквально.За 24 часа черт учит все разделы математики. Начиная с базовой алгебры, до комплексных геометрических понятий и неэвклидовых геометрий. К концу дня черт не справляется с задачей профессора. Однако суть не в этом, а в том, что бес проникается математикой, начиная искренне интересоваться возможным решением великой теоремы ферма. Таким образом показывая, что математика тоже может быть интересной сферой для обучения, если понимать основные концепций и давать все себя ей.
Впечатления: #Хорошее сочетание шуток, как выше указанное цифры в квадратах или « а что у тебя есть решение? У меня есть муж» и серьезной темы о интерессах создают хорошую иммерсивность и пищу для размышлений. Черт, что не находил времени для занятия с математикой и злился, что профессор дал ему такую нудную ношу изучать бесконечные разделы чисел, вдруг находит себя искренне интересующимся решением задачи придумывая свои теорий для решений, чем увлекает и профессора.
Вывод: #Стоит пробовать себя во всем. Кто знает, может это занятие, которое ты считаешь нудным, станет новой страстью твоей личности. + Математика настолько неразборчива для полного понимания, что даже Черт об него ногу сломит.

Detailed analysis of this story you can expect from Viretasium’s video: “Exposing the Monsanto Conspiracy”
Monsanto – or how it is often called by US residents Monsatan – already had been doing its money-hungry business for more than 10 years. During the period of which happened to distribute noxious chemical weapons, provoke inner conflicts between farmers (leading to lethal accidents), and create conspiracy just to have monopoly over crops and farmlands.
Long story short, Its all begins peacefully from the independent experiment of farmer which was aimed to discover the best anti-weed chemical. Testing just about hundreds of chemicals – farmer founds one that facilitated the growth of weed at first, but became lethal with more dose sprayed. Soon, it was found out that this chemical was 2,4-D herbicide. Looking for more, he begun experimenting on this chemical, soon discovering similar one now called 2,4,5-T herbicide.
All of this have been happening just before war ended. So after, when communication canals been corrected, more and more independent researchers begun sharing with the same discoveries of 2,4-D and 2,4,5-T acids. And from here the protagonist Monsanto corp. gets included to the story: predator notices long-term pray to exploit.
At first, upon mentioned acids were warranted to be non-toxic for human or animal species, though, unexpected accident happened. Sudden explosion in the factories of Monsanto emitted huge black smog. Even though, the chemicals believed to me harmless, after the explosion the workers of Monsanto reported rare skin deceases. However, public didn’t pay much attention to it.
It is after years of this incident independent dermatologist from Britain decided to examine this. Eventually, concluding that even a little difference in temperature during the 2,4,5-T production could create a deadly chemical that can alter skin. While Britain production companies take instant actions to address this issue, Monsanto decides to ghost all of this warning papers, which leads to inhumane consequences.
Shortly, Vietnam ask for help US to cause deforestation in some regions they are fighting for. And coincidentally the neglectfulness of Monsanto corp. makes US use 2,4,5-T in order to eradicate this green areas while Monsanto still being the leader of supplying. In the end, most of the residents get infected with skin disorders and mutations during childbirths become frequent.
It is only the concerns to shut the business made Monsanto to create new herbicides. Even though, it seemed as dead end, eventually Monsanto scientists managed to discover glyphosate, chemical 10 times efficient and safer alternative to 2,4,5-T: as the it affects the vital cell of plants that is not present in humans. After securing the patent to glyphosate, Monsanto starts to gain monopoly over market.
But their greed had no limits. Glyphosate was the herbicide that affected all plants not just weed, so farmers couldn’t apply it whenever they want. So, Monsanto think of glyphosate resistant crops, which they successfully developed using glyphosate resistant salmonella DNA.
In order to keep the total monopoly Monsanto corp. created ridiculous terms of policy when using the crops, like no distribution, no keeping the old seeds and etc. Moreover, they begun hiring private detectives to inspect the farms and check if people following it. Eventually, accusing and suing more than hungered farmers wrongly, or not. This not only grew the hatred towards Monsanto, but also inner conflicts between farmers too.
Furthermore, independent health care papers revealed possible linkage of roundup (product that Monsanto made from glyphosate) use to cancer. After which thousands of people begun reporting that. It appeared cell that glyphosate kills may not be present in human, but maybe in its micro-organisms. It is here fearing to lose everything Monsanto begun corrupting research papers and organizations to stay afloat, all of which been discovered by leaked documents. And still claiming the safeness of glyphosate herbicide. But if the product your selling is truly safe, then what is the motive of involving in corruption and conspiracy.

content:
Main Takeaways #@LuisFNovelo’s quote Early in my career as a developer, a seasoned engineer told me: First, make it, then, make it work, lastly, if you can, make it pretty. That approach saved me a ton of time.
Impostor syndrome will not leave you anytime. Start anyway! You don’t need to feel confident, just need to be willing Practice a lot instead of tutorial hell Problem solving is important Burnout is real: Take breaks, have boundaries, play and enjoy Mini essay #Topic: Theory is important, but practice is more
Theory helps you understand, but practice helps you to write. Some might claim this statement as nonsense as theory is the foundation of everything, so how might one not be able to create, when it is knowledgeable. But world is not perfect, it’s behavior can neither simply learned nor predicted.
Firstly, it is impossible to learn all the theory. When even in the real world natives struggle to know for 100% their language, it for sure can’t be done in coding.
Secondly,
I bet, in the sudden burst of motivation, we all have experienced this strive to learn everything today, just by watching for tutorials. Eventually, stuck in the loop of tutorial hell, where one is able to build only by coping the author. How can you overcome this obstacle and learn to build own ideas?
title: It took me 10+ years to realize what I’ll tell you in 8 minutes

content:
Today I completed watching the second season of Tsuki ga Michibiku Isekai Douchuu (TMID), an anime that I love for its characters, dynamics, and well delivered topics. Easy flow of the show facilitates the parallels with real word, making it easier to deduce the key takeaways of it. Such as following the fate is misery, one should have his boundaries set and protected, being rational and helpful is what brings true results. Important thing that differentiates this anime from others is well minded MC. Throughout the series Makoto Misumi’s determination to fight the goddess %% (creature that unfairly praises human rase)%% creates great dynamics that lead to non-standard obstacles. Specifically in the series, goddess grants Makoto ability to talk in all languages excluding human (universal). Due to it, ugly face and frightening mana MC experiences great hatred and decides to collaborate with no-human creatures and maintains neutrality between humans, no-humans and demons specifically. But MC is not the single force that keeps this fiction unrepeatable. The world itself build different. Firstly, TMID’s goddess is introduced as complete antagonist character and has despicable character, unlike other isekai animes, where often god serves as absolute goodness and forgotten after MC’s reborn. Secondly, political tensions remain unsolved even in the war period between human and demon races compared to others where they are not introduced in the first place. Lastly, during the series we testify 2 other hero isekai, but MC (not claimed hero due to his ugly face). Where each one of three follow their own goals and faith. Nevertheless, I can’t dare claim Tsuki ga Michibiku Isekai Douchuu completely unique fiction. It uses the foundation developed by other isekai and corrects the dull part with uniqueness. Accordingly, things like MC being the strongest, creating own civilization/country, and establishing merchant lines can be discovered in most animes (Tensura, etc.) In conclusion, Tsuki ga Michibiku Isekai Douchuu presents us unimaginable and satisfying plot build from unfulfilled expectations of other isekai; though, creating sort of acceptance.
Topics:
Following the fate is misery Ugly look and universal hatred could be overcome by work, talent and results. Being hero is not your duty Tit for tat is universal strat Weak will follow the fool, strong will follow the well minded One can set free, when it becomes the strongest Determination %% One of the few animes that I think well balanced in terms of dynamics; well thought protagonist, deuteragonists and antagonists behavior/goals. Particularly, TMID has charming 1MC and other characters all of which differentiate with their ability to feel alive. Almost all of characters introduces in TMID has their unique thoughts, goals and history. But most importantly Unlike homogenous isekai shows, TMID has a perfect balance between protagonist and antagonist sides. In fact, it creates ambiguous case, where protagonist acts neutral, but at the same time faces multiple antagonists from both human and demon sides. Dynamics %%
